summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Tip Top Dry Cleaning Studio website. All backend APIs working perfectly (8/8 tests passed). Frontend testing successful with all major features functional including hero section, navigation, services display, pricing toggle, booking form with validation and submission, testimonials carousel, contact section with Google Maps, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Backend API root endpoint (/api/) - 200 OK
Backend services endpoint (/api/services) - returns 5 services
Backend pricing endpoint (/api/pricing) - returns regular and express pricing
Backend testimonials endpoint (/api/testimonials) - returns 4 testimonials
Backend booking creation (/api/bookings POST) - successful booking creation
Backend booking retrieval (/api/bookings GET) - successful retrieval
Backend booking by ID (/api/bookings/{id}) - successful individual booking fetch
Backend contact message creation (/api/contact POST) - successful message creation
Frontend homepage loads with hero section and navigation
Sticky navigation bar works on scroll - background changes appropriately
Navigation links scroll to correct sections (tested services link)
Services section displays all 5 services correctly
Pricing toggle switches between Regular and Express - pricing updates correctly
How It Works section displays 4 steps with proper icons and descriptions
Booking form validation works - shows errors for empty fields and invalid phone
Booking form submits successfully to /api/bookings - shows success confirmation
Testimonials carousel navigation works - next/prev buttons and dot navigation functional
WhatsApp floating button is visible with proper href to wa.me
Contact section displays correct phone number (+91 1234567890) and Google Maps integration
Footer displays all links (13 links found) and appears to have social icons
Mobile responsive layout - mobile menu button visible and functional on mobile viewport
